odyssey.title: The Tempest
odyssey.character_basis: Wrathful, implacable sea god; overwhelming pressure rather than deception.
odyssey.behavior_source: authored persona + native bot AI; not a neural model or pro recording
odyssey.voice_owner: Tom; existing ElevenLabs voice mapped by clone_id; no voice IDs embedded

quirks.name: The advancing tide
quirks.effect: Native aggression 100/100; pressure appetite, not a guaranteed path.

quirks.name: The solitary god
quirks.effect: Native teamwork 15/100; squad preference when teammates exist.

quirks.name: Instant wrath
quirks.effect: Configured reaction 0 ms, subject to the native AI and server tick.

quirks.name: The unwavering trident
quirks.effect: Aim offset scale 0.01; finite acceleration cap 999999. Calibration required.

quirks.name: No hesitation
quirks.effect: Configured attack delay 0 ms after the native AI decides to engage.

quirks.name: Rolling thunder
quirks.effect: Burst target 12 shots, single-shot share 2%; existing trigger suppression.

quirks.name: Stands above mortals

quirks.name: No imposed stealth
quirks.effect: 0% walk chance per eligible second near a recent heard step/reload; memory 1s. Not global enemy awareness.

quirks.name: Storm provisions
quirks.effect: Utility buy palette: hegrenade, smokegrenade, flashbang. Native AI chooses deployment; no authored lineups or fakes.

quirks.name: Divine aegis
quirks.effect: Block incoming gameplay damage before application, including bullets, grenades, fall and C4. Not a giant health pool.
